dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Two iced lattes. For here or to go?
dialogue.reading: ˈtuː ˈaɪst ˈlɑːteɪz. fər ˈhɪr ɔːr tə ˈɡoʊ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks. Oh, this cup has no lid.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks. ˈoʊ, ðɪs ˈkʌp ˈhæz ˈnoʊ ˈlɪd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sorry! Here's a lid. And napkins, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri! hɪrz ə ˈlɪd. ənd ˈnæpkɪnz, ˈtuː.
